title: Oil is oil, water is water
meaning_odia: ତେଲ ଓ ପାଣିର ନାମକୁ ଅଲଗା ଅଲଗା ଦୋହରାଯାଇଛି। ଆମର ବ୍ୟାପକ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟାରେ, ଦୁଇଟି ଭିନ୍ନ ଜିନିଷକୁ ଏକ କରି ନଦେଖି ସେମାନଙ୍କ ପାର୍ଥକ୍ୟ ଚିହ୍ନିବାର ଇଙ୍ଗିତ ଏଥିରେ ଅଛି। ମୂଳରେ କୌଣସି ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ଘଟଣା କିମ୍ବା ପ୍ରୟୋଗ କୁହାଯାଇନାହିଁ।
explanation: Each substance is named twice, with a pause between the two. Our broad editorial reading is that different things keep distinguishable identities and should not simply be treated as the same. This reading draws on the familiar contrast between oil and water; a fixed traditional gloss has not been verified.
usage_example: Original imagined example: A discussion treats two quite different problems as though they were interchangeable. Someone repeats “oil, oil; water, water” to ask that the distinction be kept clear.
cultural_context: The force lies in economy: four nouns, no stated action. Repetition gives the two substances separate verbal places, leaving a listener to supply the situation.

witnesses.locator: Page22, ninth item, ତେଲ ତେଲ, ପାଣି ପାଣି.
